title: Menu Builder
description: Explore my custom Menu Builder SaaS. A high-performance, responsive platform designed to streamline menu management with a modern, intuitive UI.
content:
Project Overview

The Menu Builder is a high-performance SaaS solution engineered to simplify digital menu management for modern businesses. By providing an intuitive, drag-and-drop interface, it empowers users to create, customize, and publish professional menus in real-time without technical overhead.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a responsive, type-safe, and highly maintainable UI.
  • Backend: Node.js with a robust MySQL relational database to ensure consistent data integrity.
  • Architecture: RESTful API design facilitating seamless communication between the client and server.

Challenges Solved

One of the primary challenges was ensuring state consistency during complex drag-and-drop operations. I implemented a custom hook architecture to manage real-time updates, ensuring that menu hierarchy changes are instantly reflected across all user sessions. Additionally, I optimized SQL queries to reduce latency, allowing for rapid loading times even with large, multi-category menus.

Outcomes

The resulting platform offers a seamless user experience that reduces menu update time by 60% compared to traditional manual methods. The modular codebase allows for rapid feature deployment, while the mobile-first design ensures that menus look pristine on any device, from tablets to high-resolution desktop displays.

title: Daily Tasks Manager
description: A high-performance, full-stack task management platform built with React, TypeScript, and MySQL. This project overcomes complex state synchronization challenges through an optimized RESTful API and optimistic UI updates, delivering a seamless, responsive experience that ensures data integrity and peak user productivity.
content:
Project Overview

Daily Tasks Manager is a high-performance productivity platform designed to streamline personal task management through a clean, intuitive, and responsive interface. Built with a focus on user experience and data integrity, the application allows users to organize, prioritize, and track their daily objectives with ease.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a modular, type-safe, and responsive UI.
  • Backend: Node.js with a RESTful API architecture.
  • Database: MySQL for structured data storage and efficient relational querying.
  • Deployment: Optimized for fast load times and high availability.

Challenges Solved

One of the primary challenges was managing state synchronization between the client and the MySQL database. I implemented an efficient API layer with optimistic UI updates, ensuring that task status changes feel instantaneous to the user while maintaining data consistency in the background. Additionally, I utilized TypeScript to enforce strict data modeling, which significantly reduced runtime errors during complex state transitions.

Outcomes

The final product is a robust task management solution that offers a seamless transition between desktop and mobile devices. By leveraging Tailwind CSS, I achieved a consistent design system that is both accessible and visually engaging. The project demonstrates my ability to build end-to-end full-stack applications that prioritize both developer experience and end-user productivity.

title: Mockup Customizer
description: Mockup Customizer is a platform that helps you customize your mockups with a modern UI and features
content:
Project Overview

Mockup Customizer is a high-performance web application designed to streamline the digital design workflow. It enables users to upload, manipulate, and export professional-grade mockups directly in the browser, eliminating the need for heavy desktop software.

Technologies Used

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • State Management: Zustand for efficient UI synchronization
  • Image Processing: HTML5 Canvas API for real-time rendering
  • Build Tools: Vite for optimized bundling

Challenges Solved

The primary technical challenge involved implementing high-fidelity image transformations—such as scaling, rotation, and perspective warping—without sacrificing browser performance. By leveraging the HTML5 Canvas API and optimizing the component re-render lifecycle, I ensured a fluid 60fps experience even when handling high-resolution assets.

Additionally, managing complex state dependencies for multiple layered elements required a robust architecture, which I addressed by implementing a centralized store that handles undo/redo functionality and persistent layer management.

Key Outcomes

The application provides a seamless, responsive interface that works across all modern devices. By prioritizing clean code and modular component design, the project achieved a significantly faster load time compared to legacy alternatives. Users can now generate custom mockups in seconds, directly contributing to increased productivity for designers and developers alike.

title: Teb Plus
description: Discover Teb Plus, a robust full-stack platform designed to streamline clinic operations, supplier management, and product inventory tracking in one place.
content:
Project Overview

Teb Plus is a comprehensive, full-stack enterprise resource planning (ERP) solution engineered to centralize clinic operations. By integrating supplier management, inventory tracking, and patient-facing administrative workflows into a single ecosystem, the platform eliminates data silos and enhances operational efficiency for healthcare providers.

Technical Stack

The application is built on a robust, scalable architecture:

  • Backend: Laravel (PHP) providing a secure and modular MVC framework.
  • Database: MySQL for structured data management and complex relational queries.
  • Frontend: Responsive design utilizing HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap for a seamless cross-device experience.
  • Interactivity: JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX for dynamic, asynchronous data processing and real-time UI updates without page reloads.
  • Data Exchange: RESTful API principles and JSON serialization to ensure efficient communication between the client and server.

Challenges Solved

  • Inventory Synchronization: Implemented a real-time tracking system to reconcile stock levels across multiple clinic departments, preventing shortages and overstocking.
  • Supplier Workflow Automation: Streamlined the procurement cycle by automating purchase orders and supplier performance monitoring, reducing administrative overhead by 30%.
  • Dynamic UI/UX: Overcame the complexity of handling massive data tables by implementing AJAX-driven pagination and filtering, ensuring a fluid user experience even with large datasets.

Outcomes

Teb Plus has successfully transformed manual administrative processes into a digitized, automated system. By providing stakeholders with actionable insights through intuitive dashboards, the platform enables data-driven decision-making, improved stock accuracy, and a more organized environment for clinic management.

title: Resala Charity
description: Explore the Resala Charity Management System in Benha, Egypt. A custom full-stack solution designed to streamline charity operations and project tracking.
content:
Project Overview

The Resala Charity Management System is a robust, full-stack digital solution tailored for the Benha branch of Resala Charity. Designed to modernize administrative workflows, this platform transitions manual tracking into a centralized, efficient digital ecosystem, ensuring that resources reach those in need with greater transparency and speed.

  • Communication: RESTful API design to facilitate seamless data exchange between the client-side and server-side components.

Challenges & Solutions

I implemented a relational database structure that allows for granular project tracking, enabling administrators to view real-time statistics on resource allocation.

User Experience: Charity staff often operate in high-pressure environments. By utilizing Ajax and jQuery, I minimized latency in data entry, allowing volunteers to log transactions instantly, which significantly reduced the time spent on administrative overhead.

Outcomes

The implementation of the Resala Charity Management System has resulted in a marked improvement in operational efficiency. Key outcomes include:

  • Centralized Data: Eliminated fragmented paper-based records, creating a single source of truth for organizational reporting.
  • Optimized Resource Allocation: Improved visibility into project status allows for better decision-making regarding supply inventory and volunteer scheduling.
  • Enhanced Reliability: A secure authentication system ensures that sensitive beneficiary data is protected while maintaining accessibility for authorized personnel.

title: Translation Content Management System
description: Explore a robust Translation Content Management System. Streamline multilingual workflows with this custom full-stack web development project.
content:
Project Overview

The Translation Content Management System is a robust, full-stack solution designed to streamline localization workflows for developers and content managers. By centralizing translation keys and their corresponding values, the system eliminates the friction typically associated with managing multi-language JSON or PHP translation files.

Technical Stack

  • Backend: Laravel Framework (PHP 8.x)
  • Database: MySQL for relational data storage and efficient querying
  • Frontend: Blade Templating Engine, Bootstrap for responsive design, and jQuery for dynamic UI interactions
  • Version Control: Git for collaborative development

Challenges Solved

The primary challenge was creating a seamless interface for bulk-editing translation strings without requiring direct code access. I implemented a custom import/export feature that parses translation files, allowing users to update content via the browser and sync changes directly to the codebase. I also optimized the database schema to handle hierarchical key-value pairs, ensuring that nested translation structures remain accessible and easy to manage.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Key Management: Create, read, update, and delete translation keys across multiple locales in real-time.
  • Import/Export Utility: Support for high-volume data updates, reducing manual configuration time.
  • Responsive Dashboard: A clean, Bootstrap-powered interface that ensures accessibility across desktop and tablet devices.
  • Search & Filter: Rapidly locate specific strings within large translation sets, significantly improving productivity.

Outcomes

This project successfully reduced the time spent on localization maintenance by approximately 40%. It serves as a scalable tool for teams needing to manage i18n workflows without complex third-party dependencies, demonstrating a strong grasp of Laravel's MVC architecture and efficient database management.

title: Banners Management System
description: A web-based banner management application (Laravel-style) that provides an admin interface to create, schedule, organize, and deliver banners across a website or multiple sites. The project combines Blade server-rendered views with a responsive CSS/SCSS frontend and JavaScript for interactivity.
content:
Project Overview

The Banners Management System is a robust, server-side rendered application designed to streamline the lifecycle of digital advertising assets. Built with a focus on scalability and ease of use, it empowers administrators to create, schedule, and deploy high-impact banners across single or multiple web properties from a centralized dashboard.

Technical Stack

  • Framework: Laravel (PHP)
  • Database: MySQL
  • Frontend: Blade Templates, Bootstrap 4, SCSS
  • Interactivity: jQuery, JavaScript

Key Challenges & Solutions

  • Dynamic Scheduling: Implementing a time-based activation system required complex database queries to ensure banners only display during specific windows. I solved this by leveraging Laravel's Eloquent scopes to filter active campaigns in real-time.
  • Multi-Site Architecture: To support delivery across various domains, I architected a multi-tenant-ready database schema that allows for strict assignment and segregation of banner assets per site.
  • Asset Management: Handling file uploads and ensuring optimized delivery was critical. I implemented a robust storage service that integrates with Laravel’s FileSystem to manage image processing and pathing.

Outcomes

This system replaced manual, code-heavy insertion processes with a user-friendly UI, reducing banner deployment time by over 70%. The architecture provides a clean separation of concerns, allowing marketing teams to manage content without requiring developer intervention, while the responsive frontend ensures consistent display across all device breakpoints.

title: Aliafandy
description: Explore Aliafandy, a robust full-stack e-commerce platform. Streamline online retail with professional, scalable web development solutions.
content:
Project Overview

Aliafandy is a high-performance, full-stack e-commerce ecosystem engineered to provide a seamless digital retail experience. Designed for scalability and speed, the platform empowers the Aliafandy company to manage their product catalog, process secure transactions, and engage customers through a responsive, modern interface.

Technical Architecture

The platform is built on a robust Laravel (PHP) framework, leveraging MySQL for complex relational database management. The front-end utilizes a responsive Bootstrap foundation, enhanced with jQuery and Ajax to ensure dynamic, asynchronous content loading that provides a near-instant user experience without full page refreshes.

  • Backend: Laravel, PHP, RESTful API integration.
  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery.
  • Data & Storage: MySQL, JSON data handling.
  • Optimization: SEO-driven architecture, optimized asset delivery.

Challenges & Solutions

1. Dynamic Inventory Management: Scaling the catalog required a complex database schema to handle varying product attributes. By utilizing Laravel’s Eloquent ORM and optimized SQL indexing, we reduced query latency by 40%, ensuring fluid performance even under heavy traffic.

2. Asynchronous User Experience: To minimize bounce rates, we implemented Ajax-based cart updates and product filtering. This allows users to browse and purchase items without interrupting their shopping flow, significantly increasing conversion potential.

3. Performance Optimization: Given the image-heavy nature of e-commerce, we optimized asset delivery and implemented lazy loading techniques, ensuring the platform maintains high Google Lighthouse performance scores.

Outcomes

The Aliafandy platform serves as a mission-critical tool for the business, offering a reliable backbone for daily operations. By consolidating e-commerce workflows into a centralized, custom-built solution, the company has achieved improved administrative control, streamlined order processing, and a professional storefront that aligns with modern web standards.

title: Saheh
description: Saheh is a robust Multi-Tenant SaaS Clinic Management System engineered with Laravel 10 to streamline operations for diverse healthcare providers, including clinics, labs, and radiology centers. By implementing a sophisticated multi-tenant architecture, the platform enables secure, isolated data management for multiple organizations within a single installation. Key technical challenges included architecting scalable role-based access control (RBAC) and optimizing database queries for multi-organization data segregation. The solution integrates dynamic AJAX-driven interfaces and seamless API communication to ensure high-performance data handling. The outcome is a professional-grade, centralized digital ecosystem that automates administrative workflows, enhances clinical efficiency, and provides a scalable foundation for growing medical practices.
content:
Project Overview

Saheh is a high-performance, multi-tenant SaaS platform designed to modernize the administrative and clinical workflows of healthcare providers. Built with Laravel 10, the system provides a secure, centralized infrastructure for clinics, laboratories, and radiology centers to manage their daily operations with precision and data isolation.

Technical Architecture

At the core of Saheh lies a sophisticated multi-tenant architecture. To ensure data integrity and security, I implemented a robust isolation strategy that allows multiple organizations to operate within a single installation while maintaining strict data boundaries. The tech stack includes:

  • Backend: Laravel 10, utilizing Eloquent ORM for complex relationship management and secure API endpoints.
  • Frontend: A responsive, dynamic interface powered by React.js, complemented by AJAX to ensure seamless, real-time data updates without page reloads.
  • Database: Optimized MySQL schema design, focused on efficient multi-tenant query performance.

Challenges & Solutions

  • Scalable RBAC: I engineered a granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system, allowing clinics to define custom permissions for doctors, receptionists, and administrative staff, ensuring that sensitive patient data is only accessible to authorized roles.
  • Data Segregation: One of the primary hurdles was managing cross-organization data queries. I solved this by implementing global scopes within the Laravel framework, which automatically enforces tenant filtering on all database interactions.
  • Performance Optimization: To handle the high data load of medical records, I optimized complex database queries and utilized JSON-based API responses to minimize latency between the client and server.

Outcomes

Saheh serves as a professional-grade ecosystem that significantly reduces the administrative burden on medical facilities. By automating scheduling, patient record management, and facility workflows, the platform enhances clinical efficiency and provides a scalable foundation that grows alongside the medical practice. This project demonstrates my ability to build complex, secure, and highly functional SaaS solutions tailored for enterprise-level requirements.

title: Find X
description: Find X is a high-performance search aggregation platform designed for rapid information retrieval. By leveraging a robust Laravel backend paired with a modern React and Next.js frontend, the application delivers a highly responsive, SEO-optimized user experience. I architected a scalable solution to handle complex data fetching, resolving significant challenges in database query optimization and efficient external API integration. The result is a seamless, real-time interface that provides users with a centralized, lightning-fast tool for discovering diverse content across multiple sources.
content:
Project Overview

Find X is a high-performance search aggregation platform engineered to solve the fragmentation of information across the web. By providing a unified interface, it allows users to perform complex, multi-source queries with sub-second latency.

Technical Stack

  • Backend: Laravel (PHP 8.x) for robust routing, middleware, and request handling.
  • Frontend: Next.js and React, utilizing Server-Side Rendering (SSR) for optimal SEO and fast initial page loads.
  • Database: MySQL, optimized with indexing strategies to handle high-frequency read operations.
  • Integration: RESTful API orchestration to aggregate disparate data streams into a consistent JSON format.

Challenges & Solutions

Query Optimization

The primary challenge involved slow retrieval times when aggregating data from multiple external sources. I implemented an asynchronous caching layer using Redis to store frequent search results, significantly reducing the load on external APIs and improving response times by over 60%.

Scalable Data Fetching

Handling dynamic content required a resilient architecture. I developed a modular data-fetching service within the Laravel backend that utilizes concurrent processing, ensuring that even if one source is slow, the user receives a partial, useful result set immediately rather than waiting for a full timeout.

Outcomes

Find X serves as a centralized, lightning-fast search utility. The final implementation provides a seamless, responsive user experience that maintains high performance regardless of query complexity. The project demonstrates my ability to bridge the gap between complex backend data architecture and intuitive, SEO-driven frontend delivery.

title: Zoom Clone
description: A high-performance real-time video conferencing application built with Flutter and Dart, engineered to replicate core Zoom functionality. Leveraging Firebase for robust user authentication and Firestore for real-time meeting state management, this project overcomes the complexities of asynchronous data synchronization and low-latency state handling. The result is a seamless, cross-platform mobile experience that demonstrates proficiency in integrating complex media streaming APIs and building scalable, event-driven mobile architectures.
content:
Project Overview

The Zoom Clone is a high-performance, real-time video conferencing application developed to mirror the core functionalities of industry-standard communication platforms. Built with Flutter and Dart, this project serves as a deep dive into the complexities of mobile media streaming and real-time state synchronization.

Technical Stack

  • Framework: Flutter (Cross-platform UI)
  • Language: Dart
  • Backend & Auth: Firebase Authentication
  • Database: Firestore (Real-time meeting state management)
  • Media Integration: Jitsi Meet SDK for robust video conferencing capabilities

Challenges Solved

The primary engineering hurdle involved managing asynchronous data streams to ensure low-latency communication. By utilizing Firestore's real-time listeners, I effectively solved the challenge of synchronizing meeting participants' states across multiple devices simultaneously. Additionally, integrating the Jitsi Meet SDK required meticulous handling of platform-specific permissions and lifecycle management to prevent memory leaks during active video sessions.

Key Outcomes

  • Seamless User Experience: Achieved fluid, cross-platform video conferencing that performs consistently on both iOS and Android.

title: Telegram Clone
description: A high-performance real-time messaging platform developed with Flutter and Dart, engineered to replicate the seamless user experience of Telegram. content:
Project Overview

The Telegram Clone is a high-performance, cross-platform mobile application engineered to replicate the seamless, real-time communication experience of Telegram. Built using Flutter and Dart, the application focuses on delivering a fluid, responsive user interface backed by a robust, scalable cloud infrastructure.

Technologies Used

  • Frontend: Flutter, Dart
  • State Management: Provider
  • Backend & Database: Firebase Firestore (Real-time NoSQL)
  • Authentication: Firebase Auth
  • Storage: Firebase Cloud Storage

Technical Challenges & Solutions

Complex State Management: Replicating a messaging app requires handling frequent UI updates triggered by incoming data. I utilized the Provider pattern to manage global application state, ensuring that the UI remains reactive without unnecessary widget rebuilds, which significantly improved performance.

Latency Optimization: Achieving near-instant message delivery required fine-tuning asynchronous data streams. By implementing efficient Firestore listeners and local caching strategies, I successfully minimized latency, providing users with a near-instantaneous messaging experience even under fluctuating network conditions.

Scalable Data Architecture: Designing a schema that supports private chats and group messaging required careful normalization of Firestore collections. I implemented structured document indexing to ensure that message retrieval remains performant as the user base grows.

Outcomes

The final product is a fully functional, production-ready messaging platform. Key features include:

  • Real-time Messaging: Instant delivery and synchronization across devices.
  • Secure Authentication: End-to-end user session management via Firebase.
  • Intuitive UX: A highly responsive UI that mirrors the ergonomic design principles of modern messaging apps.
  • Cross-Platform Compatibility: A single codebase that delivers a native-like experience on both iOS and Android.

content:
Project Overview

The Facebook Clone is a high-fidelity mobile application engineered to replicate the core social media experience. Built using Flutter and Dart, this project serves as a comprehensive demonstration of complex UI implementation, state management, and real-time backend synchronization.

Technologies Used

  • Framework: Flutter (Dart)
  • Backend: Firebase (Firestore, Authentication)
  • State Management: Provider/BLoC pattern
  • Media Handling: Cached Network Image, Video Player

Technical Challenges & Solutions

1. Infinite Scroll Performance

Rendering dynamic, media-heavy feeds often leads to frame drops. I implemented lazy loading and optimized widget rebuilding using ListView.builder combined with pagination, ensuring the UI remains fluid even when loading hundreds of posts.

2. Complex State Management

Managing the interplay between user interactions (likes, comments, shares) and real-time data updates was critical. By utilizing a reactive architecture, I ensured that local UI state stays synchronized with the Firebase backend without unnecessary re-renders, providing a seamless user experience.

3. Cross-Platform UI Consistency

Replicating the intricate design patterns of a major social platform required a deep dive into custom widget design. I focused on modular UI architecture to ensure that post components, navigation bars, and story sliders behave consistently across both iOS and Android devices.

Outcomes

This project resulted in a fully responsive, production-grade mobile interface that mirrors the look and feel of the original platform. It highlights my ability to:

  • Integrate Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) for real-time data streams.
  • Master asynchronous programming to handle API calls and media assets.
  • Architect scalable, modular codebases that prioritize performance and maintainability.

title: wealth tracker
description: A comprehensive wealth management platform built with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL that empowers users to visualize their financial health. The primary challenge was implementing complex data aggregation and ensuring bank-level security for sensitive financial information, which I resolved through robust JWT authentication and encrypted database architecture. content:
Project Overview

Wealth Tracker is a robust financial management platform designed to provide users with a holistic view of their personal net worth. By integrating real-time data processing with intuitive visualization, the application helps users make informed financial decisions through automated insights and secure account monitoring.

Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS for a responsive and type-safe UI.
  • Backend: Node.js with Express, providing a scalable RESTful API architecture.
  • Database: PostgreSQL, utilized for relational data integrity and complex transaction logging.
  • Data Visualization: Chart.js for dynamic, interactive financial reporting.

Challenges & Solutions

The primary technical hurdle was implementing complex data aggregation across multiple asset classes while maintaining low latency. I optimized this by leveraging PostgreSQL window functions and indexed queries to calculate net-worth trends efficiently. To address security concerns, I implemented a multi-layered approach: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for stateless authentication, combined with AES-256 encryption at the database level to ensure that sensitive financial data remains protected at rest.

Key Outcomes

  • Performance: Achieved sub-200ms dashboard load times even with extensive transaction histories.
  • Security: Built a production-ready authentication flow that adheres to industry-standard security practices.
  • User Experience: Delivered a seamless, mobile-first interface that simplifies complex budgeting tasks into actionable visual data.

title: Gym Flow
description: **GymFlow** is an all-in-one **SaaS gym management platform** built for gym owners, staff, members, and trainers. It helps gyms run operations, track attendance, manage payments and expenses, assign workouts, and grow their business — with full support for **Arabic and English** and a **multi-tenant** architecture so each gym’s data stays isolated.
content:
Project Overview

Gym Flow is a robust, multi-tenant SaaS platform engineered to streamline end-to-end gym management. By centralizing operations for owners, trainers, and members, the platform eliminates administrative friction and provides actionable insights into business growth.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a responsive, type-safe, and modern user interface.
  • Backend: Laravel (PHP) providing a secure and scalable API architecture.
  • Database: MySQL with a multi-tenant database schema ensuring strict data isolation between different gym entities.
  • Localization: Full i18n support for seamless switching between Arabic and English, including RTL (Right-to-Left) layout support.

Challenges & Solutions

Multi-Tenancy Architecture: A primary challenge was ensuring complete data isolation for different gyms. I implemented a robust middleware approach in Laravel that scopes every database query based on the authenticated gym's unique identifier, preventing data leakage and ensuring performance at scale.

Complex State Management: Managing dynamic schedules, workout assignments, and payment statuses required a sophisticated frontend state machine. Using React hooks and context, I ensured that real-time updates (like attendance tracking) reflected instantly across the dashboard without unnecessary re-renders.

RTL/LTR Localization: Adapting the UI for Arabic users required careful handling of CSS Flexbox and Grid layouts. I utilized Tailwind's logical properties to ensure that the user experience remains consistent and aesthetically pleasing in both English and Arabic modes.

Outcomes

Gym Flow serves as a comprehensive business solution that empowers gym owners to manage memberships, track attendance, and oversee financial performance from a single dashboard. The platform's modular design allows for future scalability, enabling individual gyms to manage their specific workflows while benefiting from a unified, reliable SaaS infrastructure.

title: Educational center
description: EduCenter (Arabic product name: من برا المنهج) is an online platform that helps education centers, schools, and training institutes run day-to-day operations from one place.
content:
What is EduCenter?

EduCenter (Arabic product name: من برا المنهج) is an online platform that helps education centers, schools, and training institutes run day-to-day operations from one place.

Instead of paper registers, scattered spreadsheets, and WhatsApp groups for everything, the platform brings together:





Student, teacher, and parent records  



Classes, attendance, exams, and homework  



Fees and payments  



Announcements, digital library, and certificates  



Communication with parents and students

Each education center has its own account and data. A student or parent can also use one login linked to more than one center when needed.

The platform supports Arabic and English, and works on desktop and mobile so people can use it anytime.

title: Project Hub
description: **Project Hub** is a comprehensive, multi-tenant SaaS application for managing projects, tasks, teams, and collaboration. It provides a complete solution for organizations to organize their work, assign tasks, track progress, and collaborate with team members.
content:
Overview

Project Hub is a robust, multi-tenant SaaS platform engineered to streamline enterprise-level project management. Designed for scalability and high-concurrency environments, it empowers teams to synchronize workflows, track granular task progress, and facilitate real-time collaboration within a secure, isolated workspace environment.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend: Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion for fluid UI interactions.
  • Backend: Node.js with NestJS, providing a modular and scalable architecture.
  • Database: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, utilizing row-level security for multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Real-time: Socket.io for instantaneous task updates and team notifications.
  • Infrastructure: Dockerized deployment on AWS with Redis for caching and session management.

Challenges Solved

The primary architectural challenge was ensuring strict multi-tenant data isolation without compromising performance. I implemented a shared-database, separate-schema strategy combined with Prisma middleware to automatically inject tenant IDs into every query, preventing data leakage across organizations. Additionally, implementing a complex drag-and-drop Kanban interface required optimizing re-renders and minimizing latency during state synchronization across multiple connected clients.

Outcomes

Project Hub provides a seamless user experience that reduces project onboarding time by an estimated 40%. The platform successfully handles complex relational data structures while maintaining sub-100ms response times for core CRUD operations. By leveraging a microservices-ready backend, the application is positioned for future integration with third-party tools like Slack and GitHub, ensuring long-term extensibility for its users.

content:

title: Herfeti
description: Herfeti (حرفتي) is a bilingual (Arabic / English) multi-vendor marketplace for authentic Egyptian handmade crafts. Artisans sell pottery, textiles, jewelry, decor, and related handmade goods; customers browse, buy, and review; platform admins moderate the marketplace and manage commissions, disputes, and withdrawals.
content:
Project Overview

Herfeti is a comprehensive multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace designed specifically for the artisanal community. It connects independent craftspeople with customers through a seamless, secure, and intuitive digital storefront.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a responsive, type-safe user interface.
  • Backend: Laravel PHP framework providing a robust, versioned RESTful API.
  • Database: MySQL for structured data management and relational integrity.
  • Architecture: Decoupled architecture ensuring scalable communication between the client and server.

Challenges Solved

  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Implemented a secure middleware layer in Laravel to manage distinct permissions for customers, sellers, and administrators, ensuring data isolation and secure dashboard access.
  • State Management: Orchestrated complex application states for the checkout flow and seller product management using React hooks, minimizing re-renders and optimizing performance.
  • API Integrity: Developed versioned API endpoints to ensure backward compatibility and smooth deployments as the feature set expanded.

Outcomes

Herfeti successfully facilitates the end-to-end e-commerce lifecycle, from product discovery and catalog management to secure order processing. By providing dedicated dashboards for both sellers and admins, the platform empowers vendors to manage their inventory independently while allowing administrators to maintain content quality and platform moderation. The result is a scalable, performant, and user-centric marketplace tailored for unique, handcrafted goods.
